<Color> Airship Hull Paint is a consumable only available from the [[DDO Store#Airship Color Changes|DDO Store]].

* Can not be purchase unless the purchasing character is in a guild.

This item lets you change the color of the airship exterior hull and walls

* Can only be used when on the guild airship.

* This color will be permanent until changed to a new color.
